tasks.title: Merge user data from three sources
tasks.objective: Read, map, merge, and resolve conflicts across three user data sources (JSON, CSV, Parquet) and produce merged Parquet and conflict JSON reports.

factSources.description: Script output from running merge_users.py showing merged dataset with 4 users and conflict report with 3 conflicts

outputContracts.description: Merged Parquet file at /app/merged_users.parquet with schema: user_id (int), name (string), email (string), created_date (string YYYY-MM-DD), status (string, optional). Conflict report at /app/conflicts.json.

facts.statement: merge_users.py executes successfully, reads all three sources, maps fields, merges by user_id with priority-based conflict resolution
Merged dataset contains 4 unique users (101-104) with correct schema: user_id (int64), name (string), email (string), created_date (string), status (string)

maps.title: Merge user data from three sources

nodes.title: Inspect input data files
nodes.contextSummary: Read and understand the schema and content of all three source files before building merge logic.

nodes.title: Implement user data merge script
nodes.contextSummary: Read source_c Parquet, then write a Python script to map fields, merge by user_id with priority (source_a > source_b > source_c), resolve conflicts, output merged_users.parquet and conflicts.json.

nodes.title: Run merge script and validate output
nodes.contextSummary: Run merge_users.py, verify merged_users.parquet and conflicts.json outputs are correct.

nodes.title: Add validation to merge script
nodes.contextSummary: Add automated validation assertions to the script and rename to merge_and_validate.py. Script already works - just needs explicit exit-code-based assertions.
